name: ft-lookup-privacy-wall
description: R210 P2 (security plan section 2 / section 5): the lookup privacy wall on the 200 leg, BOTH directions. Sam Rivera (site_mod, the real scrypt door) reads the lookup door: Jordan's row (showEmail false) must render with the email ABSENT from the API body everywhere (search + detail + history), and Alex's row (showEmail true) must render WITH the email present - the wall is per-persona, enforced in the projection, not the UI.

steps.name: lookup-search-200-jordan-row-email-hidden
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/user-lookup?q=jordan', false); x.send(); const b = x.responseText; return 'status=' + x.status + ' row=' + (b.includes('Jordan Lee') ? 'present' : 'absent') + ' emailLeak=' + (b.includes('jordan@example.com') ? 'TRUE' : 'false') })()

steps.name: lookup-detail-200-jordan-email-hidden
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/user-lookup?userId=u_me', false); x.send(); const b = x.responseText; const h = ((JSON.parse(b) || {}).history) || []; return 'status=' + x.status + ' row=' + (b.includes('Jordan Lee') ? 'present' : 'absent') + ' emailLeak=' + (b.includes('jordan@example.com') ? 'TRUE' : 'false') + ' historyRows=' + h.length })()

steps.name: lookup-search-200-alex-row-email-shown
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/user-lookup?q=alex', false); x.send(); const b = x.responseText; return 'status=' + x.status + ' row=' + (b.includes('Alex Chen') ? 'present' : 'absent') + ' emailShown=' + (b.includes('alex@freetrader.app') ? 'true' : 'FALSE') })()

steps.name: lookup-no-match-honest-empty
steps.expr: (() => { const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('GET', '/api/moderation/user-lookup?q=zzz-nobody-r210', false); x.send(); const b = x.responseText; return 'status=' + x.status + ' users=' + ((JSON.parse(b) || {}).users || []).length })()
